definitionZh: :future CSS 伪类选择器是一个时间维的伪类,它将匹配任何完全在匹配: current 的元素之后出现的元素. 例如,在WebVTT显示的带字幕的视频中。
sourceDefinition: The :future CSS pseudo-class selector is a time-dimensional pseudo-class that will match for any element which appears entirely after an element that matches :current. For example in a video with captions which are being displayed by WebVTT.
